angle-between-vectors.name: Angle Between Two Vectors
angle-between-vectors.intro: Compute the angle between two vectors from their components using θ = arccos(a·b/(|a||b|)), returned in both radians and degrees.

arc-length.name: Arc Length Calculator
arc-length.intro: Compute arc length from radius and central angle using L = r·θ, with built-in degrees-to-radians conversion.

chord-length.name: Chord Length Calculator
chord-length.intro: Compute chord length from radius and central angle in radians using c = 2r·sin(θ/2).

circle-area.name: Circle Area Calculator
circle-area.intro: Compute circle area from radius using A = π·r².

circle-circumference.name: Circle Circumference Calculator
circle-circumference.intro: Compute circle circumference from radius using C = 2π·r.

cone-frustum-volume.name: Conical Frustum Volume Calculator
cone-frustum-volume.intro: Compute the volume of a conical frustum from the upper radius r, lower radius R and height h using V = πh/3·(R² + Rr + r²).

cone-volume.name: Cone Volume Calculator
cone-volume.intro: Compute cone volume from base radius and height using V = πr²h/3.

cube-properties.name: Cube Properties Calculator
cube-properties.intro: Compute cube volume V = a³, surface area A = 6a² and space diagonal d = a√3 from edge length a.

cylinder-volume.name: Cylinder Volume Calculator
cylinder-volume.intro: Compute cylinder volume from base radius and height using V = πr²h.

distance-3d.name: 3D Distance Calculator
distance-3d.intro: Compute the straight-line distance between two points in 3D space using d = √[(x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)² + (z₂−z₁)²].

dot-product-2d.name: 2D Dot Product Calculator
dot-product-2d.intro: Compute the dot product a·b = a_x·b_x + a_y·b_y of two 2D vectors, including the projection length of a onto b.

ellipse-area.name: Ellipse Area Calculator
ellipse-area.intro: Compute ellipse area from the semi-major axis a and semi-minor axis b using A = π·a·b.

ellipsoid-volume.name: Ellipsoid Volume Calculator
ellipsoid-volume.intro: Compute ellipsoid volume from three semi-axes a, b and c using V = 4/3·π·a·b·c.

midpoint-2d.name: 2D Midpoint Calculator
midpoint-2d.intro: Compute the midpoint of a line segment from endpoints (x₁,y₁) and (x₂,y₂) using M = ((x₁+x₂)/2, (y₁+y₂)/2).

parabola-vertex.name: Parabola Vertex Calculator
parabola-vertex.intro: Compute the vertex coordinates (x_v = −b/2a, y_v = f(x_v)) and axis of symmetry of a quadratic y = ax² + bx + c from its coefficients.

point-line-distance.name: Point-to-Line Distance Calculator
point-line-distance.intro: Compute the shortest distance from point (x₀,y₀) to line Ax + By + C = 0 using d = |Ax₀ + By₀ + C| / √(A² + B²).

polygon-interior-angle.name: Regular Polygon Interior Angle Calculator
polygon-interior-angle.intro: Compute each interior angle of a regular polygon from side count n using θ = (n−2)·180°/n.

pyramid-volume.name: Pyramid Volume Calculator
pyramid-volume.intro: Compute pyramid volume from base area and height using V = (1/3)·base area·height.

pythagorean.name: Pythagorean Theorem Calculator
pythagorean.intro: Compute the hypotenuse from legs a and b using c = √(a² + b²).

rectangle-diagonal.name: Rectangle Diagonal Calculator
rectangle-diagonal.intro: Compute rectangle diagonal from width w and height h using d = √(w² + h²).

rectangular-prism-volume.name: Rectangular Prism Volume Calculator
rectangular-prism-volume.intro: Compute rectangular prism volume V = l·w·h and surface area from length, width and height.

regular-polygon-area.name: Regular Polygon Area Calculator
regular-polygon-area.intro: Compute regular polygon area from side count n (n ≥ 3) and side length s using A = n·s²/(4·tan(π/n)).

sector-area.name: Sector Area Calculator
sector-area.intro: Compute circular sector area from radius and central angle in radians using A = r²θ/2.

sphere-surface-area.name: Sphere Surface Area Calculator
sphere-surface-area.intro: Compute sphere surface area from radius using A = 4πr².

sphere-volume.name: Sphere Volume Calculator
sphere-volume.intro: Compute sphere volume from radius using V = (4/3)πr³.

torus-volume.name: Torus Volume Calculator
torus-volume.intro: Compute torus volume from major radius R (to tube center) and tube radius r using V = 2·π²·R·r².

trapezoid-area.name: Trapezoid Area Calculator
trapezoid-area.intro: Compute trapezoid area from the two bases a, b and height h using A = (a+b)h/2.

triangle-heron.name: Triangle Area Calculator (Heron's Formula)
triangle-heron.intro: Compute triangle area from three side lengths a, b, c using A = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)) with semi-perimeter s.
